Causalean's identification stack (Causalean/SCM/ID/, Causalean/SCM/Do/, SWIGGraph/fixSet) is SWIGNode-specialized, so an abstraction bridge from the mixed-graph carrier to a latent-variable SCM would have to be built before the statement could even be typed -- a partial fit, deliberately not treated as a discharge. The paper's honest_scope imports this equivalence; no delivered theorem depends on it.

Frozen cited gate (AlimontiKann2000, Thm 3.1): APX-completeness of Minimum Vertex Cover on graphs of maximum degree at most three. Round-5/7 form: APX MEMBERSHIP plus the (P != NP)-conditional no-approximation-below-a-threshold half, both quantified over Mathlib's sound `Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime` and over REAL approximation ratios (D-R). Remaining upstream layer: an NPO-problem universe with the AP/L-reduction calculus (so that `APX-hard` can be stated universally rather than operationally), a `FinEncoding` library for graphs, and the PCP theory the source's proof needs -- none of which exists in Mathlib (only `SimpleGraph.vertexCoverNum` and the bare TM2 poly-time predicate are available). Separately, and no longer part of this item (round 8, D-S): closure of `TM2ComputableInPolyTime` under composition, which Mathlib itself records as the unproved `proof_wanted TM2ComputableInPolyTime.comp` (Computable.lean:284), is clause (vi) of the user-approved core atom `ass:uniform-poly-time-model` and is carried as that atom's binder by this gate's consumer `thm:objective-preserving-hardness`.

ROUND-8 RE-KEYING (D-S): the core split the old node, so this item now keys the frozen CITED half `lem:ugc-vertex-cover-hardness-source`; the former id `lem:ugc-vertex-cover-hardness` is a PROVED paper-owned lemma (the canonical-source-carrier specialization) and is therefore no longer debt. Frozen cited gate (KhotRegev2008): under UGC, no polynomial-time (2-epsilon)-approximation for Minimum Vertex Cover. Round-5/7 form: the approximation predicate is fully defined over Mathlib's vertex-cover API at a REAL ratio and the slack is quantified as `epsilon : Real` (D-R, so the gate covers its consumer's positive-real epsilon exactly, with no rational-density bridge), and poly-time is Mathlib's sound `Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime`, so the only opaque component left is the UGC antecedent itself. Remaining upstream layer: a self-contained formulation of the Unique Games gap problem (requested by review, not fabricable here -- the frozen core supplies UGC only as a name), the multilayered PCP the source's proof needs, and a `FinEncoding` library for graphs. Separately, and no longer part of this item (round 8, D-S): closure of `TM2ComputableInPolyTime` under composition, recorded upstream as the unproved `proof_wanted TM2ComputableInPolyTime.comp` (Computable.lean:284), is clause (vi) of the user-approved core atom `ass:uniform-poly-time-model` and is carried as that atom's binder by `thm:tight-frontier`.

ROUND-8 RE-KEYING (D-S): the core split the old node, so this item now keys the frozen CITED half `lem:rational-lp-polynomial-time-source`; the former id `lem:rational-lp-polynomial-time` is a PROVED paper-owned lemma (the canonically indexed specialization) and is therefore no longer debt. Frozen cited gate (Korte-Vygen Thm 4.18): a polynomial-time algorithm for rational linear programming returning an optimum basic solution. Round-5 form: stated for GENERAL rational LPs in inequality form, guarded by the source's own `if there exists one` (existence of an optimal basic solution), with basicness = extremality in the LP's own variable space and poly-time = Mathlib's sound `Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime`. Partial-fit discharge route on file: CausalSmith's `Substrate.WeakRationalConvexOptimization.weak_rational_convex_optimization` gives oracle-polynomial WEAK (approximate) rational convex optimization, so the gap to close is exact optimality plus basic-solution structure for an explicit LP, together with a `FinEncoding`-level ellipsoid/simplex implementation. Needed only for the polynomial-time clauses of the two eventual consumers, `thm:rank-three-rounding` and `prop:optimizer-or-violation`, which now reach it through the proved lemma `lem:rational-lp-polynomial-time` and record it in their `propagated_hyps` (round 8, D-S); LP attainment is proved in-run in both.
